claim_boundary: This is the final read-only local-fidelity architecture-selection gate on frozen development seeds 1901 and 1902. It does not train v2, fit a probe, use a relation or correctness oracle, or access formal seeds. After this gate, choose and register a v2 candidate on new development seeds rather than adding post hoc localization on 1901 and 1902.

crossing_regime.intermediate: not early and mean sign-change lambda_minus < 0.60
crossing_regime.no_crossing: no positive-to-nonpositive mean transition by lambda 1

aggregate_crossing.grid_status: robust_positive if the bootstrap lower bound is above zero, robust_negative if the upper bound is below zero, otherwise unresolved; lambda zero is structural_zero
aggregate_crossing.mean_sign_change_bracket: the first adjacent nonzero grid points [lambda_minus,lambda_plus] with mean c(lambda_minus)>0 and mean c(lambda_plus)<=0; do not interpolate a root
aggregate_crossing.per_relation_curve: participant-bootstrap mean direct correctness at every fixed lambda for every one of the eight relations
aggregate_crossing.primary_relation: H>A, index pair [7,0], prospectively selected by the prior frozen result
aggregate_crossing.robust_transition_bracket: the last grid point before the first robust-negative point whose bootstrap lower bound is above zero, paired with that first later point whose bootstrap upper bound is below zero

amplitude_path.baseline: b_q is the full relation-LOO response preactivation
amplitude_path.fixed_output: the trained action-margin covector W_out[action1]-W_out[action0] at its trained scale
amplitude_path.hodge_residual: apply the registered complete-graph residual projector independently at every lambda, relation, and subject
amplitude_path.lambda_one: must reproduce the prior exact-H estimands and actual intact-minus-LOO logit influence
amplitude_path.lambda_zero: the complete field and every residual must be exactly zero
amplitude_path.scalar_field: orientation-antisymmetric W_out projection on all 28 canonical query edges

curvature.interpretation: negative H>A K2 with weaker or positive other-relation K2 supports a relation-conditioned output-opposed curvature component; call this curvature, not generic saturation
curvature.quadratic_coefficient: K2 = -tanh(b) elementwise-multiplied by [1-tanh(b)^2] elementwise-multiplied by A^2
curvature.scalar_and_hodge_processing: project K2 through the same fixed W_out, orientation contrast, and Hodge residual as the exact path
secondary_estimands: aggregate retained direct correctness of K2
per-relation retained direct correctness of K2
H>A K2 direct correctness minus the within-subject mean of other retained relation K2 correctness
second-order approximation error at each nonzero fixed lambda
curvature.taylor_identity: H(lambda) = lambda J_b A + lambda^2 K2 + O(lambda^3)

subject_crossing.boundary: subject brackets describe heterogeneity; no adaptive or subject-specific root solving is permitted
subject_crossing.denominator: all retained subjects for that relation, without filtering on competence, initial sign, or crossing
subject_crossing.first_crossing_bracket: for each retained subject and relation, the first adjacent nonzero grid pair with c_s(lambda_minus)>0 and c_s(lambda_plus)<=0
reported: proportion with a fixed-grid positive-to-nonpositive crossing
proportion nonpositive at the first nonzero lambda
median, quartiles, and counts of first crossing brackets among crossing subjects

v2_entry.after_this_gate: do not add further local-fidelity localization on seeds 1901 and 1902
v2_entry.formal_confirmation: forbidden until a v2 candidate and estimands are frozen after the one-to-three-seed pilot
v2_entry.new_development_seeds: one to three seeds not used by the read-only localization series
v2_entry.online_computability: the v2 mechanism may use normal query and fast-weight state but not relation LOO, true labels, correctness, or a relation-identity oracle
required_gates: learned-pair local fidelity improves under a frozen estimand
global expected-rank assembly, nonlearned inference, and query binding are preserved
a selective causal intervention supports the proposed expression mechanism

v2_selection.heterogeneous_or_nonreplicated_crossings: register the simplest online relation-conditioned v2 that predicts the observed heterogeneity; do not continue post hoc localization on seeds 1901 and 1902
v2_selection.isolated_early_or_intermediate_H_greater: choose an online relation-conditioned expression or routing v2 rather than a global scalar correction
v2_selection.isolated_late_H_greater_A_crossing: choose a relation-conditioned amplitude-control v2; global clipping is not justified because the other relations remain correct
v2_selection.no_H_greater_A_crossing: treat this as an integrity contradiction with the locked A/J/H result and stop before v2
v2_selection.widespread_early_or_intermediate_crossin: choose a fidelity-preserving near-linear residual expression v2 rather than relying on the current finite nonlinear path
v2_selection.widespread_late_crossing: choose a globally magnitude-bounded or residualized-expression v2, while preserving global assembly and testing relation controls

overall_diagnosis.next_step: freeze an online-computable v2 on one to three new development seeds
